items.text: Incorporated all three workshop decisions into plan.md. d1=B: Ollama now gets an async health check (GET /api/tags, 2s timeout) in addition to config-presence — plan Phase 1 updated with goroutine + context.WithTimeout approach. d2=A: OpenRouter stays config-presence only — plan explicitly prohibits key format validation. d3=A: Tests use table-driven subtests — plan Phase 2 updated with 5 subtests including an 'ollama configured but unreachable' case.
All source file references verified against current codebase: scanner_plugin.go L304-339, generate.go L51-74, config.go L94-114, scanner_plugin_test.go L299+, aigen/provider.go L15-28 — all accurate.

Readiness upgraded to 3/3 across all dimensions. The health check decision (d1=B) was the main gap in approach_solid and risk_awareness — now that the strategy is locked (async with 2s timeout, goroutine concurrency), implementation path is fully clear. Testing plan expanded from 4 to 5 cases to cover the unreachable-Ollama scenario introduced by the health check.

plan_updates: Updated plan sections 3 (scope), 5 (target end state), 6 (implementation strategy), 7 (testing plan), 8 (risks), 9 (non-goals), and 10 (definition of done) to reflect: Ollama async health check with 2s timeout, OpenRouter config-presence only, table-driven tests with 5 subtests including unreachable case, and explicit prohibition on key format validation and cached health checks.
